functions.name: create_customer_org

functions.name: get_customer_health_score

functions.name: get_my_entitlements
functions.description: Returns every features.key whose min_tier rank <= the caller org's carrier_details.tier rank. Batched has_feature().

functions.description: Tier gate: true if the caller org's tier rank >= the feature's min_tier rank. See hasFeature section.

functions.name: mark_overdue_invoices

functions.description: RLS helper: the active caller's profiles.org_id (NULL if no active profile).

functions.name: my_role

functions.name: next_entity_val
functions.description: Per-org monotonic counter (upsert into org_sequences) used to mint load/invoice/customer numbers. SECURITY INVOKER.

hasFeature.volatility: VOLATILE (not marked STABLE, unlike get_my_entitlements which is STABLE)
hasFeature.definition: SELECT (SELECT rank FROM tiers WHERE code = (SELECT tier FROM carrier_details WHERE org_id = my_org_id())) >= (SELECT rank FROM tiers WHERE code = (SELECT min_tier FROM features WHERE key = feature_key));
hasFeature.semantics: Pure tier-rank comparison. True iff rank(caller org's carrier_details.tier) >= rank(features.min_tier for feature_key). Nothing else is considered.
hasFeature.trialHandling: NOT handled. billing_status='trialing' and trial_ends_at are ignored. A trialing org on tier='pro' keeps every Pro feature after trial_ends_at passes, until something else changes carrier_details.tier.
hasFeature.graceHandling: NOT handled. grace_period_until exists on carrier_details and is written by the /admin SuperAdmin UI (admin_events 'admin.grace_period') but has_feature() never reads it.
hasFeature.suspensionHandling: NOT handled. billing_status='past_due' or 'canceled' has zero effect on entitlements. Entitlement revocation on non-payment must be done by mutating carrier_details.tier - there is no independent kill switch.
hasFeature.flagOverrideHandling: NOT handled. org_flag_overrides / platform_flags are a SEPARATE, currently-unused system (both tables are empty) and are not consulted.

edgeCases.case: caller has no active profile row (my_org_id() IS NULL)
edgeCases.note: NULL, not false. In an RLS USING clause NULL denies. In TypeScript hasFeature() the wrapper coerces with `data === true`, so NULL -> false (fails closed). A raw .rpc() caller that does `if (data)` also fails closed since NULL is falsy.

edgeCases.case: caller's org has no carrier_details row (e.g. a customer-type or platform-type org, incl. the sx_* SuperAdmin org)
edgeCases.note: ShipmentX staff on the platform org are entitled to NOTHING by has_feature(); /admin must not gate on it.

edgeCases.case: feature_key does not exist in features
edgeCases.note: Typo in a feature key silently fails closed rather than erroring - no referential check on the argument.
Column is nullable with DEFAULT 'starter', so only reachable by explicit NULL write.

calledFromSQL.note: ZERO SQL callers. No RLS policy and no other DB function calls has_feature(). Despite the 'RLS-usable' framing in schema.sql comments and lib/entitlements.ts, every gate is enforced in application code only.

calledFromTypeScript.ungatedNote: 4 of the 14 rows in `features` have no has_feature() call site anywhere in either app - they are advertised in tier marketing/entitlement lists but not enforced.

entitlementModel.model: Two independent systems. (1) tiers/features/carrier_details.tier -> has_feature()/get_my_entitlements(): live and enforced in app code. (2) platform_flags/org_flag_overrides: schema exists, both tables EMPTY, no reader anywhere in SQL or TypeScript - dead/未wired.

tiers.rls: RLS on; 2 policies; anon has SELECT (marketing/pricing page)

features.rls: RLS on; single policy features_select FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true) - readable by every authenticated user of every tenant, by design
features.note: No feature has min_tier='starter' or 'enterprise'. Enterprise currently unlocks nothing beyond Pro.

carrierDetails.note: tier is the ONLY column has_feature() reads. billing_status / trial_ends_at / grace_period_until are recorded and shown in /admin but have no enforcement path.

platformFlags.rls: sx_platform_flags_select (SELECT to sx_owner/sx_finance/sx_support), sx_owner_platform_flags_write (ALL to sx_owner)
platformFlags.status: DEAD - zero rows, zero readers in SQL or TypeScript

orgFlagOverrides.rls: sx_org_flag_overrides_select (SELECT to sx_*), sx_owner_org_flag_overrides_write (ALL to sx_owner)
orgFlagOverrides.status: DEAD - zero rows, zero readers. Note the intended per-org override cannot currently affect any gate because has_feature() ignores it.

getMyEntitlements.semantics: Same tier-rank rule as has_feature(), applied to every features row. Returns an empty set (not an error) when my_org_id() is NULL or the org has no carrier_details row.
getMyEntitlements.note: getEntitlements() is exported in both apps but has ZERO call sites - the batched primitive the design doc recommends is unused; every surface does individual has_feature() round trips instead.

billingEvents.note: event_type and status are free-text with no CHECK; table is empty

defaultPrivileges.public.tables(owner=postgres): anon=Dxtm, authenticated=Dxtm, service_role=Dxtm (TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER, MAINTAIN) - NOT SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE

autoExposure.explanation: A newly created public table owned by postgres grants authenticated only Dxtm - no SELECT. It is NOT auto-exposed; schema.sql SECTION 8c's blanket GRANT ... ON ALL TABLES is what makes existing tables readable. A future new table added without re-running that GRANT returns zero rows silently (documented in supabase/schema/README.md).
autoExposure.anonTruncateNote: anon holds TRUNCATE (+REFERENCES, TRIGGER) on all 39 public tables via Supabase default privileges. TRUNCATE bypasses RLS entirely. Not reachable through PostgREST (no TRUNCATE verb) but is a latent privilege that should be REVOKEd.

booleanLifecycleFlags.note: my_org_id()/my_role() return NULL when false - deactivation kills all RLS access

statusColumns.enumNote: There are ZERO Postgres enum types in this database. Every vocabulary is TEXT + CHECK, so Supabase generated types are plain `string` with no compile-time exhaustiveness (see supabase/schema/README.md step 3).

schemaDrift.method: Object-name diff between supabase/schema/schema.sql (2492 lines) and live introspection of the running supabase_db_carrieros container. Full replay against a scratch DB was NOT performed (read-only audit).

liveOnly.impact: DRIFT. Exists in the live DB but is absent from schema.sql. It is a strict subset of the existing same_org_profiles_select policy (which already covers the caller's own row via org_id = my_org_id()), so dropping it on a fresh replay would not change effective access - but it is an undocumented divergence and a `db reset` would silently remove it. Likely a leftover from an early bootstrap before my_org_id() existed.

policies.verdict: 1 policy of drift (live has one extra). All 5 storage.objects policies and all 94 shared public policies match by name.

otherNotes: supabase/schema/README.md line 82 states 'a clean replay yields 0 errors, 35 tables, 80 policies' as of 2026-07-21. Live is now 39 tables / 100 public+storage policies. The README's counts are STALE and should be refreshed.
docs/carrieros-db/schema.sql (the Zoho copy) was not compared - docs/ is a gitignored symlink outside this audit's scope. supabase/schema/schema.sql is authoritative per its README.
